name: fx1
setup: window.__setup((race)=>{const s=race.getStandings(); const me=race.karts[3]; me.starPower=6; for(const k of race.karts){ if(k!==me){k.item='gumdrop';k.itemCharges=1;race.items.use(k);} } })
